songFromText.about: A file imported (mergeRepeats: a section written out again is sung again, not kept twice): its sections, the order they're sung in, the key it starts in, and a copyright line before the first section. A comment naming a section ("Strophe 2", "Refrain", "Pont") sets the type and label of the one after it, and a "2. " numbering its first line is dropped; the site's address and a comment saying the key changes are left out.

a note before a section stays its note
without mergeRepeats, a section written twice stays twice
a chorus again, two semitones up: a pass transposed
a chorus again with one chord different: a pass with that chord
half its chords different: a section of its own
the end of the chorus written out: a pass of its last lines
a chord site's page: details on top, chords above the words, a repeat in words

findRepeats.about: A song's sections that repeat an earlier one (issue #231), each with the earlier one and how: the same, every chord moved alike (transposed), at most a third of its chords different (its own, written in the song's key), or a run of its lines. With which of the earlier's lines and chords each of its own is.

linkRepeats.about: The song with its repeats linked (issue #231): each repeat gone, its passes now passes of the section it repeats - transposed, with its own chords, or its other lines left out.

sectionHeading.about: Whether a line only names a section, in the languages songs come in: its type and its number or letter.
